tools.name: check_pair
tools.description: Speculatively merge two PR branches onto base and return a bound per-pair verdict (COMPATIBLE / TEXTUAL-CONFLICT / SEMANTIC-BREAK / UNTESTED) with a rebase instruction. Args: repo_id, a, b.

tools.name: check_all
tools.description: Pair matrix plus full-union verdict with drop-one-out culprits. Plan repos. Args: repo_id, branches?.

tools.name: validate_verdict
tools.description: Re-validate a verdict's triple binding; returns FRESH or STALE (naming the moved head). Args: repo_id, verdict.
